page_title: WHU 0-5 LIV | West Ham v Liverpool 29/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Luis Guilherme (West Ham) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
90+3' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
90+2' The ball has crossed the sideline. West Ham are taking a throw-in.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
89' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
88' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
88' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
84' 0 - 5 Diogo Jota (Liverpool) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the right post in trademark fashion.
83' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Alphonse Areola stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
81' That will be all from Mohammed Kudus who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Luis Guilherme (West Ham).
80' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
80' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
79' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is flagged offside and it's not the first time today.
78' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
77' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
76' The linesman signals that Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
75' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
74' Substitution. Andrew Robertson makes way for Konstantinos Tsimikas (Liverpool).
74' Here is a change. Curtis Jones is going off and Arne Slot gives the last tactical orders to Harvey Elliott (Liverpool).
73' A substitution has been made. Carlos Soler is replaced by Andrew Irving (West Ham).
72' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) shoots the rebound towards the goal. His effort lacks pace and that allows the goalkeeper to pull off a stunning save.
70' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alisson, who smothers the ball.
68' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is penalised for a foul. Anthony Taylor had a clear view and blows his whistle.
66' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
66' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from West Ham for a penalty. Play continues.
65' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) fancies his chances and unleashes a powerful shot from the edge of the box, but the keeper just watches it go high over the bar.
64' The current number of shots on goal is 0:10.
62' Half-chance! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) plays a pass into the box, but Alphonse Areola reacts well to snuff out the attack.
61' A player from Liverpool brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
60' The manager makes a subsitution with Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) coming on for Jarrod Bowen.
60' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
58' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Cody Gakpo and he is replaced by Diogo Jota (Liverpool).
57' Substitution. Ryan Gravenberch walks off the pitch and Wataru Endo (Liverpool) comes on as a substitute.
56' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for West Ham.
54' 0 - 4 Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) receives a brilliant pass and sends a long-range shot past the helpless goalkeeper. What a cracking goal!
53' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
52' The cross into the penalty area from Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
51' Anthony Taylor couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) and blew his whistle.
51' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
50' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
49' One of the players from West Ham times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
47' The ball is out of play. Liverpool win a corner kick.
47' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Alphonse Areola stops the ball from going inside the left post.
46' Julen Lopetegui makes a half-time substitution. Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) comes on in place of Edson Alvarez.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jean-Clair Todibo (West Ham) will replace Vladimir Coufal.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
45+3' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
45+2' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 3 Goal! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is teed up on the edge of the box by Curtis Jones, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:3.
43' A lofted cross from Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
40' 0 - 2 Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
38' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) unleashes a tremendous shot from distance, but it crashes against the right post! If it had flown more to the left it would have been a cracker!
37' Joe Gomez is substituted due to injury. Arne Slot gives a chance to Jarell Quansah (Liverpool).
36' The game is interrupted now, Joe Gomez (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
35' A brilliant cross into the box finds Lucas Paqueta (West Ham), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
34' A pass by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

30' 0 - 1 Goal! Luis Diaz (Liverpool) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. Alphonse Areola is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 0:1.
29' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
28' West Ham win a corner.
27' Liverpool showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession.
24' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
24' Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
23' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Alphonse Areola stops the ball from going into the top of the net.
22' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball.
18' The ball spins to Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
17' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
17' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Liverpool earn a corner.

16' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Alphonse Areola shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
15' Liverpool play a few nice passes from player to player, but their possession doesn't last long as an opposition player intercepts a pass.
13' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) serves up a nice cross, but Alphonse Areola punches the ball away.
11' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
9' Anthony Taylor blows for a foul after Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
9' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
8' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post.
8' There's an opportunity for Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
7' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the right side of the goal, but Alphonse Areola pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
6' What a big chance! Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post.
6' The game is interrupted. One of the players from West Ham is cautioned for aggressive play.
5' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for West Ham.
4' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for an infringement.
3' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

The players are out at last! West Ham will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Anthony Taylor.
